full_name: 100-item visual acuity survey (100 yes/no everyday-task items linked to acuity demand)
domains: self-reported ability to recognise details of everyday objects at specific viewing distances
scoring: IRT two-parameter logistic ability (theta); estimated VA = 0.59 - 0.33 x theta (Equation 1 p6); single or combined items scored No = positive (all No for pairs/triplets)
target_population: adults 18+ spanning a broad VA range (-0.3 to 2.0 logMAR)
notes: item difficulties -2.65 to 1.69 logits, covering approx 0.15-1.47 logMAR; five items had suboptimal IRT fit in earlier work; ceiling effect in 14% of sample; development paper is Wu 2024 TVST (ID 128), details not in this paper (p3)
